title: Andy Weir says his new sci-fi audio drama 'Exoplanet' is a way to 'revive the old art of radio plays' (interview)
caption:
Andy Weir is turning back the clock. His new audio drama, Exoplanet, revives the golden age of radio plays with a star-studded time-travel thriller.
